steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: A design brief defines the problem — who is the audience, what is the message, what are the constraints.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The design process is iterative: research, ideas, development, refinement, feedback, revision.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Mind-mapping and mood boards help generate and organise ideas visually at the start of a project.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Presenting to a client requires clear rationale — explain design decisions, not just show finished work.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Create a series of experimental studies exploring the design process. Annotate your process. | Research an artist or designer who works with the design process. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work. | Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with the design process. Which approaches were most successful and why?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to the design process, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes. | A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work. | A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Address ALL four Assessment Objectives — AO1 (develop), AO2 (refine), AO3 (record), AO4 (present) Show the FULL creative journey — from initial research to final outcome Annotate your work using specialist vocabulary (not just "I like it") Draw from primary sources wherever possible — real objects, not photos Experiment with a RANGE of media and techniques before selecting Make clear connections between artist research and your own developing work
